parse.title: Pay-to-play Cooking training
parse.wikitext:
==Choosing Cooking locations==
Cooking most foods takes four [[tick|game ticks]], and 28 can be cooked per inventory. Therefore, a full inventory takes 112 ticks or 67.2 seconds, making Cooking one of the least attentive skills in the game.

Assuming no banking and no food burned, a player could theoretically cook up to 1,500 raw foods per hour; however, factoring in bank-time, players can expect to cook between 1,300 and 1,400. The following table compares the different cooking locations by their bank proximity and corresponding items cooked per hour. The table assumes the bank distance is ran, no food is burnt, and that banking takes 3 seconds (5 ticks).

<nowiki>*</nowiki>Running takes 0.5 ticks per square. A bank 4 tiles away will require you to traverse 8 tiles (there and back), so crossing 8 tiles at 2 tiles per tick will take 4 ticks.

=== Calculating exact times ===
To find the exact number of ticks to cook one inventory at any given location, players can first use the formula <chem>117+(tiles)</chem>, where <chem>117</chem> refers to the minimum ticks taken to cook and bank, and <chem>(tiles)</chem> refers to the number of tiles the cooking source is from the bank. If run is enabled, divide (tiles) by 2 and round up. Players can translate this into seconds by multiplying it by <math>0.6</math>, the number of seconds per tick.

Players can then find out how many items they can cook in an hour by taking the number of ticks and putting it into the formula <chem>(3600/(x))*28</chem>. Here, <chem>3600</chem> refers to the number of seconds in an hour, <chem>x</chem> refers to the number of '''seconds''' it takes to do one inventory, and <chem>28</chem> refers to the number of inventory spaces the player has. Players should round down to the nearest whole number.
